front.title: Update to the Automatic Bandwidth Adjustment Procedure for MPLS-TE and SR-TE LSPs with a Stateful PCE

abstract.t: This document extends the automatic bandwidth adjustment procedure in RFC 8733 to SR-TE LSPs using SR-MPLS and SRv6, and to multipath LSPs using the PCEP extensions in RFC 10066. For multipath LSPs, it defines per-path list signaling for Requested Bandwidth. It also updates RFC 8733 to define how an all-zero AUTO-BANDWIDTH-ATTRIBUTES sub-TLV value restores a default or removes an attribute.
